Rules.InvariantScript:
UpdateContext ({locSaveData: !locSaveData});
UpdateContext({locPCFDataChanged: cmp__PCF_SpreadSheet_Costs_ProjectCosts_TableCommandBar_AddDataTable.jsonDataOut});
If(
    locPCFJsonInput <> locPCFDataChanged,
    UpdateContext({locTimerStart: false});
    UpdateContext({locTimerEnd: false});
    Set(
        varJSONOUT,
        locPCFDataChanged
    );
    UpdateContext({locPCFDataJSON: ParseJSON(cmp__PCF_SpreadSheet_Costs_ProjectCosts_TableCommandBar_AddDataTable.jsonDataOut)});
    ClearCollect(
        colPCFDataOut,
        ForAll(
            locPCFDataJSON As Data,
            With(
                {
                    lclSubAccount: LookUp(
                        colCapexSubaccountsNew,
                        Name = Text(Data.Name) && Number = Text(Data.Number)
                    ),
                    lclDesc: Text(Data.Description)
                },
                {
                    Number: Text(Data.Number),
                    Name: Text(Data.Name),
                    Description: Text(Data.Description),
                    CurrentYear: Text(Data.Year),
                    CostPaidBy: Text(Data.CostPaidBy),
                    Depreciation: Text(Data.Depreciation),
                    ApplyVAT: Text(Data.ApplyVAT),
                    Jan: Value(Data.Jan),
                    Feb: Value(Data.Feb),
                    Mar: Value(Data.Mar),
                    Apr: Value(Data.Apr),
                    May: Value(Data.May),
                    Jun: Value(Data.Jun),
                    Jul: Value(Data.Jul),
                    Aug: Value(Data.Aug),
                    Sep: Value(Data.Sep),
                    Oct: Value(Data.Oct),
                    Nov: Value(Data.Nov),
                    Dec: Value(Data.Dec),
                    SubAccountID: lclSubAccount,
                    lclParentRowCol: lclSubAccount,
                    UniqueID: Data.Number & " - " & Data.Name,
                    row_ID: Text(Data.Row_ID),
                    CostUniqueID: Data.Name & "-" & Data.Number & Data.Description & Data.Year & Data.Row_ID,
                    ProjectContract: LookUp(
                        colCapexProjectContracts,
                        Name = Text(Data.Description) && Account.'CAPEX Account List' = lclSubAccount.'CAPEX Account List'
                    )
                }
            )
        )
    );
    UpdateContext(
        {
            locPCFDataJSON: Blank(),
            locPCFDataChanged: Blank()
        }
    );
    Concurrent(
        ClearCollect(
            colUniqueContracts,
            Distinct(
                colPCFDataOut,
                ProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
            )
        ),
        ClearCollect(
            colNewStandardDisallowed,
            AddColumns(
                Filter(
                    colPCFDataOut As R,
                    Not(
                        IsBlank(
                            Find(
                                "standard",
                                Lower(R.Description)
                            )
                        )
                    )/*,
                Or(
                StartsWith(
                    Lower(Trim(R.Description)),
                    "standard"
                ),"standard" in Split(Lower(R.Description)," ").Value)*/
                ),
                IsNew,
                IsBlank(ProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract')
            )
        ),
        ClearCollect(
            colValidationPCFOutRow,
            AddColumns(
                colPCFDataOut As Current,
                CostCountRows,
                CountIf(
                    colPCFDataOut,
                    Name = Current.Name,
                    CurrentYear = Current.CurrentYear,
                    row_ID = Current.row_ID,
                    Number = Current.Number,
                    Description = Current.Description
                ),
                SubaccountCountRows,
                CountIf(
                    colPCFDataOut,
                    Name = Current.Name,
                    CurrentYear = Current.CurrentYear,
                    row_ID = Current.row_ID,
                    Number = Current.Number,
                    Description = Current.Description
                )
            )
        ),
        ClearCollect(
            colNonExistingSubaccountsPCF,
            Distinct(
                Filter(
                    colPCFDataOut,
                    IsBlank(SubAccountID)
                ),
                UniqueID
            ).Value
        ),
        ClearCollect(
            colDuplicateSubaccounts,
            GroupBy(
                colPCFDataOut,
                UniqueID,
                ByUniqueID
            )
        )
    );
    With(
        {
            locDuplicateSubaccounts: ForAll(
                colDuplicateSubaccounts As Current,
                If(
                    CountIf(
                        Distinct(
                            Filter(
                                colPCFDataOut,
                                UniqueID = Current.UniqueID
                            ),
                            row_ID
                        ),
                        true
                    ) > 1,
                    With(
                        {
                            locRow: LookUp(
                                colPCFDataOut,
                                UniqueID = Current.UniqueID
                            )
                        },
                        {
                            Name: locRow.Name,
                            Number: locRow.Number,
                            UniqueID: locRow.UniqueID,
                            Comment: " is duplicated. Please ensure it is unique."
                        }
                    )
                )
            ),
            locNonExistingSubaccounts: ForAll(
                colNonExistingSubaccountsPCF As Current,
                With(
                    {
                        locRow: LookUp(
                            colPCFDataOut,
                            UniqueID = Current.Value
                        )
                    },
                    {
                        Name: locRow.Name,
                        Number: locRow.Number,
                        UniqueID: locRow.UniqueID,
                        Comment: ": Cost entered below Account instead of Sub-Account."
                    }
                )
            ),
            locDuplication: ForAll(
                Filter(
                    colValidationPCFOutRow,
                    CostCountRows > 1
               // ,CurrentYear = locProjectStartingYear
                ) As Current,
                With(
                    {
                        locRow: LookUp(
                            colValidationPCFOutRow,
                            Description = Current.Description
                        )
                    },
                    {
                        Name: locRow.Name,
                        Number: locRow.Number,
                        UniqueID: locRow.UniqueID & " : " & locRow.Description,
                        Comment: " :- There cannot be two contracts with the same name under the same sub-account."
                    }
                )
            ),
            locMissingValues: ForAll(
                Filter(
                    colPCFDataOut As Item,
                    IsBlank(Item.Depreciation) || IsBlank(Item.ApplyVAT) || IsBlank(Item.CostPaidBy)
               // ,CurrentYear = locProjectStartingYear
                ) As Current,
                With(
                    {
                        locRow: LookUp(
                            colPCFDataOut,
                            Description = Current.Description && Name = Current.Name && Number = Current.Number
                        )
                    },
                    {
                        Name: locRow.Name,
                        Number: locRow.Number,
                        UniqueID: locRow.UniqueID & " : " & locRow.Description,
                        Comment: " : Please fill out the missing cost information."
                    }
                )
            ),
            locStandardDisallowed: ForAll(
                Filter(
                    colNewStandardDisallowed,
                    IsNew
                ) As ThisRow,
                {
                    Name: ThisRow.Name,
                    Number: ThisRow.Number,
                    UniqueID: ThisRow.UniqueID & " : " & ThisRow.Description,
                    Comment: " : The term ""Standard"" is applicable only for system-prefilled contracts."
                }
            ),
            locNoCostAllocatedContracts: ForAll(
                Filter(
                    GroupBy(
                        colPCFDataOut,
                        Name,
                        Number,
                        Description,
                        ByContract
                    ) As G,
                    CountIf(
                        G.ByContract As R,
                        Coalesce(
                            R.Jan,
                            0
                        ) <> 0 || Coalesce(
                            R.Feb,
                            0
                        ) <> 0 || Coalesce(
                            R.Mar,
                            0
                        ) <> 0 || Coalesce(
                            R.Apr,
                            0
                        ) <> 0 || Coalesce(
                            R.May,
                            0
                        ) <> 0 || Coalesce(
                            R.Jun,
                            0
                        ) <> 0 || Coalesce(
                            R.Jul,
                            0
                        ) <> 0 || Coalesce(
                            R.Aug,
                            0
                        ) <> 0 || Coalesce(
                            R.Sep,
                            0
                        ) <> 0 || Coalesce(
                            R.Oct,
                            0
                        ) <> 0 || Coalesce(
                            R.Nov,
                            0
                        ) <> 0 || Coalesce(
                            R.Dec,
                            0
                        ) <> 0
                    ) = 0
                ) As Current,
                With(
                    {locRow: Current},
                    {
                        Name: locRow.Name,
                        Number: locRow.Number,
                        UniqueID: First(locRow.ByContract).UniqueID & " : " & Current.Description,
                        Comment: " : Each cost item must be assigned a cost."
                    }
                )
            )
        },
        ClearCollect(
            colValidationErrors,
            locDuplicateSubaccounts,
            locDuplication,
            locMissingValues,
            locNonExistingSubaccounts,
            locStandardDisallowed,
            locNoCostAllocatedContracts
        );
    );
    ClearCollect(
        colValidationErrors,
        ForAll(
            Distinct(
                colValidationErrors,
                ThisRecord
            ),
            Value
        )
    );
    Concurrent(
        Clear(colNewStandardDisallowed),
        Clear(colValidationPCFOutRow),
        Clear(colNonExistingSubaccountsPCF),
        Clear(colDuplicateSubaccounts)
    );
    If(
        CountIf(
            colValidationErrors,
            true
        ) = 0,
        Concurrent(
            Clear(colValidationErrors),
            UpdateContext({locSpinnerInformationText: "Saving costs..."}),
            Clear(colFinatCostDataOptimized),
            RemoveIf(
                colPCFDataOut As Current,
                With(
                    {
                        locCurrentRow: LookUp(
                            colAddCostFromTable,
                            v_Year = Value(Current.CurrentYear) && s_ID = Current.ProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
                        ),
                        locContractValues: LookUp(
                            colCapexProjectContracts,
                            'CAPEX Project Contract' = Current.ProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
                        )
                    },
                    Concatenate(
                        Text(Current.Jan),
                        "|",
                        Text(Current.Feb),
                        "|",
                        Text(Current.Mar),
                        "|",
                        Text(Current.Apr),
                        "|",
                        Text(Current.May),
                        "|",
                        Text(Current.Jun),
                        "|",
                        Text(Current.Jul),
                        "|",
                        Text(Current.Aug),
                        "|",
                        Text(Current.Sep),
                        "|",
                        Text(Current.Oct),
                        "|",
                        Text(Current.Nov),
                        "|",
                        Text(Current.Dec),
                        "|",
                        Lower(
                            Trim(
                                Coalesce(
                                    Current.Depreciation,
                                    ""
                                )
                            )
                        ),
                        "|",
                        Lower(
                            Trim(
                                Coalesce(
                                    Current.CostPaidBy,
                                    ""
                                )
                            )
                        ),
                        "|",
                        Lower(
                            Trim(
                                Coalesce(
                                    Current.ApplyVAT,
                                    ""
                                )
                            )
                        ),
                        "|",
                        Lower(
                            Trim(
                                Coalesce(
                                    Current.Description,
                                    ""
                                )
                            )
                        )
                    ) = Concatenate(
                        Text(locCurrentRow.g_Jan),
                        "|",
                        Text(locCurrentRow.h_Feb),
                        "|",
                        Text(locCurrentRow.i_Mar),
                        "|",
                        Text(locCurrentRow.j_Apr),
                        "|",
                        Text(locCurrentRow.k_May),
                        "|",
                        Text(locCurrentRow.l_Jun),
                        "|",
                        Text(locCurrentRow.m_Jul),
                        "|",
                        Text(locCurrentRow.n_Aug),
                        "|",
                        Text(locCurrentRow.o_Sep),
                        "|",
                        Text(locCurrentRow.p_Oct),
                        "|",
                        Text(locCurrentRow.q_Nov),
                        "|",
                        Text(locCurrentRow.r_Dec),
                        "|",
                        Lower(
                            Trim(
                                Coalesce(
                                    Text(locContractValues.'Depreciation?'),
                                    ""
                                )
                            )
                        ),
                        "|",
                        Lower(
                            Trim(
                                Coalesce(
                                    Text(locContractValues.'Cost Type'),
                                    ""
                                )
                            )
                        ),
                        "|",
                        Lower(
                            Trim(
                                Coalesce(
                                    Text(locContractValues.'Apply VAT?'),
                                    ""
                                )
                            )
                        ),
                        "|",
                        Lower(
                            Trim(
                                Coalesce(
                                    Text(locContractValues.Description),
                                    ""
                                )
                            )
                        )
                    )
                    /*
                    And(
                        Current.Jan = locCurrentRow.g_Jan,
                        Current.Feb = locCurrentRow.h_Feb,
                        Current.Mar = locCurrentRow.i_Mar,
                        Current.Apr = locCurrentRow.j_Apr,
                        Current.May = locCurrentRow.k_May,
                        Current.Jun = locCurrentRow.l_Jun,
                        Current.Jul = locCurrentRow.m_Jul,
                        Current.Aug = locCurrentRow.n_Aug,
                        Current.Sep = locCurrentRow.o_Sep,
                        Current.Oct = locCurrentRow.p_Oct,
                        Current.Nov = locCurrentRow.q_Nov,
                        Current.Dec = locCurrentRow.r_Dec,
                        Lower(Trim(Current.Depreciation)) = Lower(Trim(locCurrentRow.e_depreciation)),
                        Lower(Trim(Current.CostPaidBy)) = Lower(Trim(locCurrentRow.d_costpaidby)),
                        Lower(Trim(Current.ApplyVAT)) = Lower(Trim(locCurrentRow.f_applyVAT)),
                        Lower(Trim(Current.Description)) = Lower(Trim(locCurrentRow.c_Description))
                    )*/
                )
            )
        );
        ClearCollect(
            colGroupedContracts,
            GroupBy(
                colPCFDataOut,
                Name,
                Number,
                Description,
                ByProjectContracts
            )
        );
        ClearCollect(
            colContractsToPatch,
            ForAll(
                colGroupedContracts As Contract,
                With(
                    {Item: First(Contract.ByProjectContracts)},
                    With(
                        {
                            locContract: LookUp(
                                colCapexProjectContracts,
                                'CAPEX Project Contract' = Item.ProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
                            )
                        },
                        {
                            Account: Item.SubAccountID,
                            Name: Contract.Description,
                            Project: gblSelectedProject,
                            'Apply VAT?': If(
                                Item.ApplyVAT = "Yes",
                                'Apply VAT? (CAPEX Project Contracts)'.Yes,
                                Item.ApplyVAT = "No",
                                'Apply VAT? (CAPEX Project Contracts)'.No
                            ),
                            'Depreciation?': If(
                                Item.Depreciation = "Yes",
                                'Depreciation? (CAPEX Project Contracts)'.Yes,
                                Item.Depreciation = "No",
                                'Depreciation? (CAPEX Project Contracts)'.No
                            ),
                            'Cost Type': If(
                                Item.CostPaidBy = "DevCo",
                                'Cost paid type'.DevCo,
                                Item.CostPaidBy = "SPV",
                                'Cost paid type'.SPV,
                                'Cost paid type'.DevCo
                            ),
                            'Distribution Scheme': 'Distribution Scheme'.'Absolute Values'
                            /*Coalesce(
                                locContract.'Distribution Scheme',
                                'Distribution Scheme'.'Absolute Values'
                            )*/,
                            Distribution: 'Distribution Type'.'Individual Distribution'
                            /*Coalesce(
                                locContract.Distribution,
                                'Distribution Type'.'Individual Distribution'
                            )*/,
                            'Owning Business Unit': gblSelectedProject.'Besitzer (Unternehmenseinheit)',
                            'Is Edited from PCF?': If(
                                And(
                                    locContract.'Is Standard Contract?' = 'Is Standard Contract? (CAPEX Project Contracts)'.Ja,
                                    locContract.'Initial Contract Source' = 'Initial Contract Source (CAPEX Project Contracts)'.Powerapps,
                                    locContract.Distribution = 'Distribution Type'.'Individual Distribution',
                                    locContract.'Distribution Scheme' = 'Distribution Scheme'.'Absolute Values',
                                    Not(locContract.'Is Edited from PCF?' = 'Is Edited from PCF? (CAPEX Project Contracts)'.Yes) || IsBlank(locContract.'Is Edited from PCF?')
                                ),
                                'Is Edited from PCF? (CAPEX Project Contracts)'.No,
                                'Is Edited from PCF? (CAPEX Project Contracts)'.Yes
                            )
                            /* If(
                                 And(
                                    locContract.Distribution = 'Distribution Type'.'Individual Distribution',
                                    locContract.'Distribution Scheme' = 'Distribution Scheme'.'Absolut Values'
                                ),
                                'Is Edited from PCF? (CAPEX Project Contracts)'.Yes,
                                'Is Edited from PCF? (CAPEX Project Contracts)'.No
                            )*/,
                            'Initial Contract Source': Coalesce(
                                locContract.'Initial Contract Source',
                                'Initial Contract Source (CAPEX Project Contracts)'.PCF
                            ),
                            ContractID: locContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
                        }
                    )
                )
            )
        );
        Patch(
            'CAPEX Project Contracts',
            ForAll(
                colContractsToPatch As Item,
                {
                    'CAPEX Project Contract': Item.ContractID,
                    Account: Item.Account,
                    Name: Item.Name,
                    Project: gblSelectedProject,
                    'Apply VAT?': Item.'Apply VAT?',
                    'Depreciation?': Item.'Depreciation?',
                    'Cost Type': Item.'Cost Type',
                    'Distribution Scheme': Item.'Distribution Scheme',
                    Distribution: Item.Distribution,
                    'Owning Business Unit': gblSelectedProject.'Besitzer (Unternehmenseinheit)',
                    'Is Edited from PCF?': Item.'Is Edited from PCF?',
                    'Initial Contract Source': Item.'Initial Contract Source'
                }
            )
        );
        Concurrent(
            ClearCollect(
                colCapexProjectContracts,
                Filter(
                    'CAPEX Project Contracts',
                    Project.Project = gblSelectedProject.Project
                )
            ),
            Clear(colAddCostDataToPatch)
        );
        ForAll(
            colPCFDataOut As Item,
            With(
                {
                    locSelectedProjectContract: LookUp(
                        colCapexProjectContracts,
                        Name = Item.Description && Account.'CAPEX Account List' = Item.SubAccountID.'CAPEX Account List'
                    )
                },
                If(
                    CountIf(
                        colCapexProjectContracts,
                        'CAPEX Project Contract' = locSelectedProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract'
                    ) = 0,
                    Collect(
                        colCapexProjectContracts,
                        locSelectedProjectContract
                    )
                );
                Collect(
                    colAddCostDataToPatch,
                    {
                        'CAPEX Cost': Coalesce(
                            LookUp(
                                colCapexCosts,
                                And(
                                    Contract.'CAPEX Project Contract' = locSelectedProjectContract.'CAPEX Project Contract',
                                    Year = Value(Item.CurrentYear),
                                    Month = [@Month].January
                                ),
                                'CAPEX Cost'
                            ),
                            Blank()
                        ),
                        Contract: locSelectedProjectContract,
                        Cost: Item.Jan,
